name: Black-faced Cormorant
rangeDescription: Coastal southern australia including tasmania and islands in bass strait
description: Large black and white cormorant with dark face, white flanks, and black

name: Rufous-throated Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of sulawesi
description: A small flycatcher with a rufous throat, a white belly, and dark gray upperparts and head. Female is duller below, with a pale line between bill and eye and a dark brown back, wings, and rump.

name: Semipalmated Plover
rangeDescription: Breeds northern north america; winters to southern south america and hawaiian islands
description: Small, orange-legged plover with solid dark breast band. Medium-brown upperparts are the color of wet sand, noticeably darker than Piping or Snowy Plovers.

name: Comoro Black Parrot
rangeDescription: Comoros (grand comoro and anjouan)
description: Fairly large, black parrot that is found in humid forest, and sometimes in adjacent plantations. Often seen in flight, sometimes in small, loose flocks.

name: Gray-throated Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern são paulo) to uruguay, paraguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Medium-sized finch with rich rusty flanks that contrast with its white belly. Note the well-marked white eyebrow and white cheeks and chin.

name: Blue-vented Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Semiarid western nicaragua to central costa rica
description: Fairly small dark hummingbird, green overall with dark blue tail. Straight, medium-length bill.

name: Salvin's Prion
rangeDescription: Breeds prince edward island and crozet island; at sea occurs in southern indian ocean and australasian seas
description: A pale powder-blue-and-white seabird with a faint grayish dark “M” across the upperwings. Note the dark blue “thumb mark” collar, the blue eye-stripe, the white eyebrow, the white throat, and the grayish cap.

name: Pin-tailed Manakin
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (espírito santo to paraná and eastern santa catarina)
description: Very small manakin with pointed central tail feathers that is found in humid forests. Males are striking with a black crown and back, a red forehead and rump, green wings, and a pale white collar and belly.
imageCreditName: João Vitor Andriola | Brazil Birding Experts

name: Red-breasted Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Northern europe to southern urals, balkans, and southern caspian; winters to southern asia
description: Distinctive, small flycatcher. Males have a rusty-orange throat that continues onto the breast.

name: Spectacled Finch
rangeDescription: Himalayas (kashmir to nepal and sikkim)
description: Bizarre and unique-looking finch. Note the lumpy diagnostic patch of bright color around the eye and forehead: red in males, yellow in females.

name: Yellow-spectacled Heleia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (sumbawa, flores, komodo, sumba, and lomblen)
description: A small green songbird with a bright yellow head and a distinctive orange forehead smudge. Gray belly separates yellow throat and yellow base to undertail.

name: Bald Parrot
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (middle rio tapajós and possibly lower rio madeira)
description: A most remarkable parrot with an entirely bare orange head and nape. Note the bright orange shoulder patch and in flight the red underwings.

name: Magellanic Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: South-central chile and argentina to cape horn archipelago and falkland islands
description: A boldly patterned large and chunky shorebird of southern South America and Falklands. Favors rocky coastlines and adjacent river mouths, but also frequent on nearby grasslands and lakeshores.

name: Bourke's Parrot
rangeDescription: Locally in acacia scrub of interior of southern australia
description: Small pale parrot of inland Australia woodlands, often found in mulga and acacia scrubland. Gray-brown scaly upperparts set off by unique pastel pink underparts and blue underwing and rump.

name: Wattled Ibis
rangeDescription: Highlands of ethiopia
description: A dark ibis with a shaggy crest and a small wattle below the bill that is difficult to see. White patches in the wings are distinctive, especially in flight.

name: Manchurian Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Northern manchuria; winters to southern china and thailand
description: Small, shy, and poorly understood, this reed warbler breeds in the remote marshlands of northeastern China and Russia and winters in drier, grassier habitats in Southeast Asia. Warm brown overall with a clean-cut whitish brow and throat; brow extends well behind the eye, unlike in Blunt-winged Warbler.

name: Red-throated Swallow
rangeDescription: Gabon and south-central democratic republic of the congo to angola and northwestern zambia
description: A small, stocky, martin-like swallow that has dark upperparts mottled around the hindneck and back, rusty throat with an indistinct partial dark collar, and a paler buffy belly. In flight, rusty rump and white blotches in the tail are distinctive.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Olive-headed Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (timor and adjacent islands from lomblen to babar)
description: A long-tailed green parrot with a light olive hood, an orange bill, and a yellowish-green underside. Note the yellow bar on the underwing in flight.

name: White-eyed Thrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest and wooded hills of jamaica
description: A medium-sized dusky bird that prefers moist montane forests, but can be also found in most wooded areas with dense vegetation. Feeds in trees and on the ground.

name: Scarlet Tanager
rangeDescription: Eastern canada and usa; winters mainly upper amazon basin
description: Breeding males are unmistakable: brilliant red with black wings and tail. Females and nonbreeding males are dull yellow-olive with dark wings (blacker on males, grayer on females).
